# Agent icons

The agent marks drawn inline in `index.html` (`AGENT_ICONS`) come from:

- **claude**, **codex** (the OpenAI mark), **opencode**: [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org), CC0 1.0.
- **agy** (the Antigravity mark), **grok**: [LobeHub Icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons), MIT License (below).
- **hermes**: a pixel "H" drawn for Vepol after the Hermes Agent banner; no third-party source.

All marks are trademarks of their owners and are used only to say which agent a session runs.
